claim: Some Blood community maps are conversions of Duke levels and say nothing about Blood: FORDTHEA (141 sectors from Duke's E1L1), Intime~2, HollHolo, Duke1 and AFTSHOCK (73) are E1L1, so FORDTHEA is not a Blood theatre exemplar. Several maps sharing one source are one witness, not several. Exemplars of a room are found by scanning every map for its parts and rendering the leads, not by file name.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-23: 'AFTSHOCK is actually conversion of E1L1 map from Duke3D'; knowledge/blood/duke-conversions.json made by experiments/room_scan/duke_conversions.py lists them.
knowledge/blood/duke-conversions.json conversions: community/FORDTHEA.MAP duke E1L1.MAP, 141 sectors, share 0.43 (read 2026-11-26)
use: Check each lead against knowledge/blood/duke-conversions.json before treating it as Blood practice.
